newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade vey slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in very a limited test. Inquiry and demand very light.

Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 900 slaughter heifers early Wednesday. Sales confirmed for the week to date 69,600 head, volume includes 20,300 head of previously contracted and formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1300 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 960-1150 lbs 65.00-65.50.
